mapper.select: select r.recharge_id, r.member_id, m.phone, r.currency, r.amount, r.status, r.audit_by, r.audit_time, r.audit_remark, r.create_time, r.remark from biz_recharge r left join biz_member m on m.member_id = r.member_id where r.recharge_id = #{rechargeId}
select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from biz_recharge where member_id = #{memberId} and currency = #{currency} and status = '1'

select ifnull(sum(r.amount), 0) from biz_recharge r inner join biz_member m on m.member_id = r.member_id where r.currency = #{currency} and r.status = '1' and ( find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) or m.member_id = #{memberId} )
mapper.insert: insert into biz_recharge (member_id, currency, amount, status, create_time, remark) values (#{memberId}, #{currency}, #{amount}, #{status}, sysdate(), #{remark})
